title.zh: BitMEX 正式关闭交易所运营并进入清盘
title.en: BitMEX officially shuts down exchange operations and enters wind-down

current_state.zh: BitMEX已重新开放美国、加拿大、香港、百慕大、塞舌尔和缅甸客户的登录、KYC和提现权限——这些地区此前被其封锁——以便他们在平台结束交易业务后取回余额，但制裁限制以及延迟提现可能产生的账户费用仍然适用。
current_state.en: BitMEX has reopened login, KYC and withdrawal access for customers in the US, Canada, Hong Kong, Bermuda, Seychelles and Myanmar — jurisdictions it had previously blocked — so they can recover balances after the platform ended trading operations, while sanctions restrictions and possible account fees for delayed withdrawals still apply.

updates.title_zh: BitMEX 关停：永续合约先驱在 11 年后正式关门
updates.title_en: BitMEX shuts down: perpetuals pioneer officially closes it doors after 11 years
updates.what_changed_zh:
BitMEX 于周三（9 月 23 日）04:00 UTC 结束全部交易所运营，停止交易与充值；两个月前的 7 月 23 日该公司已宣布启动清退。用户目前仍可登录并提现，但 API 提现将于 9 月 28 日关闭。

BitMEX 发明了加密永续合约，长期是规模最大的衍生品交易场所之一，其正式关停标志着这一产品时代的一个节点。提现通道仍然开放，公司表示本次关停与法律或监管问题无关。

已通过身份验证但未清空余额的用户，现在需支付每年 1% 或等值 50 美元（以较高者为准）的账户费用，按月收取，BitMEX 表示该费用将随时间上调。包括 KYC 复核与冷却期在内的安全措施正分阶段推出，公司还警告存在承诺加速提现的钓鱼骗局。
updates.what_changed_en: BitMEX, the perpetual-swap pioneer co-founded by Arthur Hayes, officially shut down trading and deposits after 11 years, keeping logins and withdrawals open as its wind-down continues.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: BitMEX, the perpetual-swap pioneer co-founded by Arthur Hayes, officially shut down trading and deposits after 11 years, keeping logins and withdrawals open as its wind-down continues.
updates.detailed_summary_en: BitMEX, the perpetual-swap pioneer co-founded by Arthur Hayes, officially shut down trading and deposits after 11 years, keeping logins and withdrawals open as its wind-down continues.
updates.background_zh: BitMEX 由 Arthur Hayes、Ben Delo 和 Samuel Reed 于 2014 年创立，推动了最高 100 倍杠杆永续合约的普及；公司称从未因黑客攻击损失用户资金。该交易所 2024 年就违反《银行保密法》认罪并支付 1 亿美元罚金，2025 年 3 月其三位联合创始人获美国总统唐纳德·特朗普赦免。本次关停前数日，Celsius 破产财产方起诉了五家与 BitMEX 关联的公司，指控其在 2020 年 3 月市场暴跌期间涉及欺诈、市场操纵与不当清算，涉及 6360 枚比特币。
updates.background_en: BitMEX was founded in 2014 by Arthur Hayes, Ben Delo and Samuel Reed, and popularized perpetual swaps offering up to 100x leverage; the company says it never lost user funds to a hack. It pleaded guilty in 2024 to Bank Secrecy Act violations and paid $100 million in penalties, and in March 2025 President Donald Trump pardoned its three co-founders. The closure came days after the Celsius bankruptcy estate sued five BitMEX-linked companies over alleged fraud and wrongful liquidations tied to 6,360 Bitcoin during the March 2020 crash.
updates.market_impact_zh: BitMEX 的退出会使永续合约的交易流与流动性转向其他衍生品交易场所，这一渠道主要影响的是使用其最高 100 倍合约的交易者与对冲者，他们需要另寻平台调整头寸。由于交易与充值已关闭而提现仍开放，直接传导的是交易活动与未平仓合约的迁移，而非托管或偿付能力冲击。
updates.market_impact_en: BitMEX's exit shifts perpetual-swap flow and liquidity toward remaining derivatives venues, a channel that matters most for traders and hedgers who used its up-to-100x contracts and now have to reposition elsewhere. Because trading and deposits are shut while withdrawals stay open, the immediate transmission is a migration of activity and open interest rather than a custody or insolvency shock.
